what_this_is: Measurements taken on the physical handset during the live microphone acceptance run. The phone captures and transports audio; inference runs on the backend, so the per-stage figures are backend cost for DEVICE-CAPTURED audio, not on-device inference. VIVE has no on-device inference (BLOCKERS O17).

backend_stage_latency_on_device_audio_ms.note: intent and behaviour median 0 ms because most windows were NO_SPEECH and carried no transcript to classify. AASIST is higher here than the 366 ms measured on FLEURS files.

observed_distribution.note: A quiet room with a short period of played-back speech. The 13 MEDIUM packets are those where AASIST produced a high score on genuine human speech (BLOCKERS O12).

limitations: The phone performs capture and transport only. No model runs on the device, so there is no on-device inference latency to report.
Per-stage figures are backend cost measured on one laptop; they do not transfer to other hardware.
One session, one device, one room.
